gloss: to assist; to aid; to support; to provide aid

definitions.gloss: to assist; to aid; to support; to provide aid
definitions.explanation: To provide help, especially material or financial support, to someone or a group in need. Often used in the context of international development, disaster relief, and institutional support.

examples.japanese: ⟦{発展途上国|はってんとじょうこく}→発展途上国：22732_hattentojoukoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{援助|えんじょ}する。
examples.english: To provide aid to developing countries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{被災者|ひさいしゃ}→被災者：25337_hisaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経済的|けいざいてき}→経済的：05675_keizaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{援助|えんじょ}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The government is financially supporting the disaster victims.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧や⟦{医薬品|いやくひん}→医薬品：19711_iyakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}って→送る：00742_okuru⟧{援助|えんじょ}する。
examples.english: To provide aid by sending food and medicine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国際的|こくさいてき}→国際的：06457_kokusaiteki⟧な⟦{援助|えんじょ}→援助：01892_enjo⟧なし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Without international aid, the recovery of this region will be difficult.

notes:
Typically implies organized, institutional support rather than casual personal help. Very common in discussions of international relations, foreign aid, and disaster response. Japan is a major provider of ODA (⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦{援助|えんじょ}→援助：01892_enjo⟧, Official Development Assistance).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{援助|えんじょ}→援助：01892_enjo⟧: economic aid
- ⟦{人道|じんどう}→人道：16121_jindou⟧⟦{援助|えんじょ}→援助：01892_enjo⟧: humanitarian aid
- ⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧⟦{援助|えんじょ}→援助：01892_enjo⟧: food aid
- ⟦{軍事|ぐんじ}→軍事：14392_gunji⟧⟦{援助|えんじょ}→援助：01892_enjo⟧: military aid
- ⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦{援助|えんじょ}→援助：01892_enjo⟧: development aid
- ⟦{援助|えんじょ}→援助：01892_enjo⟧{金|きん}: financial assistance, grants

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手伝|てつだ}う→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧: to help — everyday personal help
- ⟦{支援|しえん}する→支援する：25534_shiensuru⟧: to support — broader support including non-material help
- ⟦{助|たす}ける→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧: to save, to help — immediate help, less formal
